names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9635, «Иоанн (Рыбин), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after his name: «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1937)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 6 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1937).»
source.note: No rank is recorded. The day's one icon, «Совершается служба с полиелеем», stands before the apostle Thomas's line, which is the first of three, and reading a polyeleos off it for a new martyr of 1937 would be an inference rather than the source's statement.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 19 octombrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs.
Not checked: saint.gr/10/19 was not read for him (2026-10-04).
